2.  This is an application under Section 528 of BNSS preferred by the applicants for quashing Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and quash the entire proceeding of Complaint No. 686 of 2022 (Suman Vs. Manoj Sharma and others) and summoning order dated 09.12.2022 passed by Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C. Sambhal at Chandausi under section 498-A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and under section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Bahjoi, District-Sambhal.

entities.text: Suman Vs. Manoj Sharma and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. The case of the applicant is that a complaint was lodged by the opposite party no. 2 against the applicants who happen to be father-in-law, mother-in-law, nanad and married nanad under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 of the DP Act as well as against the family members including the husband who are non-applicants with an allegation that marriage of the O.P.
No.2 stood solemnized with one Manoj Sharma on 31.05.2015 at the time of the marriage,
expenditure worth 6,20,000/- was incurred as 3,20,000/- was given in cash along with other items and post marriage three children were born, however, the applicants were not happy with the gifts so offered as their demand was much more pursuant whereto on 22.10.2019 the applicants have thrown out the opposite party no. 2 from the matrimonial house on account of non-satisfaction of the demand of dowry.

Post recording of the statement under Section 200 of the Cr.P.C. of the complainant followed by of Pankaj Kumar under Section 202, Suresh Chandra Sharma, under Section 202, the applicants came to be summon on 09.12.2022 under Sections 498A, 323, 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 of the DP Act.

Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the applicants have not committed any offence the entire allegations are false incorrect and nothing but a concocted story just in order to falsely implicate the applicants.
Submission is that only general and omnibus allegations have been levelled there is no iota of evidence that any demand of dowry was made.

It is also contended that though the applicants had been summoned under Section 323 IPC but there is no injury report available on record and further the court below in a routine manner without recording any, prima facie, satisfaction has summoned the applicants who happen to be the father-in-law, mother-in-law, nanad and married nanad.

Submission is also to the extent that none of the penal provisions stand attracted and the entire prosecution theory is rest upon incorrect allegations and the statements of the witnesses are tailor-made.

It is also contended that the applicants are entitled to the benefit of the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Geeta Mehrotra Vs. State of U.P. and others reported in 2012 (10) ADJ 464.

entities.text: Geeta Mehrotra Vs. State of U.P. and others reported in 2012 (10) ADJ 464
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that already proceedings under Section 244 of the Cr.P.C. are going on.

4. Learned State Law Officer, on the other hand, submits that perusal of the allegations in the complaint, nowhere shows that there is any material contradiction or variation, which goes to the root of the matter which makes the case triable.
5. I have heard the submissions so made across the bar and perused the record carefully.

sentences.text:
In the present case, at the instance of the applicants, challenge has been raised to the summoning order summoning the applicants under Sections 498-A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and under section 3/4 D.P.
Act, there are certain broad parameters which have to be adhered to in order to find out whether there happens to be infirmity in the summoning order or not amongst others one of the criteria inevitably would be the allegation in the complaint vis-a-vis the statements under Sections 200 and 202 of the Cr.P.C., the Court finds that there are no material contradictions in the statements of the witnesses vis-a-vis the allegations contained in the complaint.

Further, the statements of the witnesses support the prosecution theory and on 20.10.2019, the applicants have thrown out the opposite party no. 2 from the matrimonial house on account of non-satisfaction of demand of dowry.

Once the position being so, it would not be appropriate for this Court, at this stage, to interfere in the proceedings as it is always open for the applicants to contest the trial taking all legal and factual issues before the court below.
7. With the above observations, the application is disposed of.
